params.documentTitle: Framework Agreement for the Supply and Maintenance of Laboratory Equipment
clauses: The Supplier delivers the listed laboratory equipment to the receiving building on time.
Maintenance visits are arranged by the facilities coordinator after a written request.
Any change to this agreement is recorded in a numbered amendment signed by both parties.
